text:
samir: quick question — featurex's debug dumps are landing in s3://featurex-debug/ with a 90d lifecycle. these files sometimes contain raw request payloads (may include customer PII). can security sign off on changing the lifecycle to 7 days and adding an ingestion-time redaction lambda? also, we need to do a one-time purge for prefix `2026-01-featurex-debug/` — who can approve that? :thinking:

alex: quick clarifying q: are these considered "logs" under our retention policy or "debug artifacts"? policy differs.

maria: hey — good flag. per infra-data-retention we treat structured request logs as 90d, but adhoc debug dumps with PII are usually set to ephemeral (<=7d) if we have a redaction step. security can approve a lifecycle change to 7d for that bucket if you add redaction and an access-plan. one-time deletion of existing objects requires a ticket + ops approval (sg-priv-ops). can you paste an anonymized sample of the payload (remove any customer identifiers) so we can confirm redaction rules?

samir: thanks. sample (anonymized):
```json
{"request_id":"REDACTED","user_id":"<removed>","prompt":"user message here","trace":{...}}
```

jordan: operational note: if you need to do the purge immediately we can run a controlled `aws s3 rm` under a runbook, but we need the ticket and the exact prefixes + time window. example command: `aws s3 rm s3://featurex-debug/2026-01-featurex-debug/ --recursive --profile redwood-deploy` (will be performed from bastion with justification logged).

sec-bot: [policy-check] bucket=featurex-debug, sensitivity=high, recent-access=team-featurex, recommendation=redact-on-put + short-ttl.

emily: for redaction: recommend attaching a PutObject Lambda that strips or masks `user_id` and `email` fields and writes a redaction-log to `s3://featurex-audit/` with minimal metadata. we already have a reusable snippet.

samir: ok i'll open a ticket (SD-4321) with prefixes, proposed lifecycle JSON and request for the one-off purge. doing that now.

amazon-lifecycle.json (current):
```json
{"Rules":[{"ID":"default-90d","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":90},"Prefix":""}]}
```

maria: thaanks — please include the anonymized sample + the redaction lambda code or link to the repo in the ticket. security can pre-approve the lifecycle change to 7d once we confirm redaction and that audit logs will be kept. note: deletion of already-stored objects is an ops action and requires sg-priv-ops approval (they will verify backups/exports first).

alex: i'll add the retention rationale and cost/latency note to the ticket. also flagged for compliance review.

deploy-bot: Lifecycle change request for bucket `featurex-debug` accepted into change window (ID: cw-789). executing on approval.

maria: one more: don't run the purge via a recursive delete from CI. prefer a staged delete with `--dryrun` then full remove from the bastion. include a rollback/backup plan in SD-4321.

samir: got it — will DM the anonymized payload + attach the redaction lambda link. thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: pinging ops for sg-priv-ops contact on the ticket.

jordan: noted — i'll standby for the runbook and can run the delete during the next maintenance window once approvals land.

maria: approved in principle for lifecycle->7d + redaction; final ok for purge after ops review + ticket attachments.

samir: thanks, closing the loop here.
